lastCompletedStory.title: Close the none-backend issue on main in the ci-gated post-merge

nextStoryContext: US-005 wired closeIssueOnMain into runPostMerge. PostMergeOutcome ok:true gained optional closeResult?: CloseIssueOnMainOutcome. Two helpers extracted for complexity compliance: performCloseStep (post-merge.ts) and buildSuccessPostMergeDoneDetail (merge-watch.ts). file-size-budget.json: events.ts ceiling raised 415->421 (tracker ref CAM-121 US-005). Tests: 2757 pass, 0 fail. check:all green.
